The Modaraba is registered under the Medaraba (Floatation and Control) Ordinance, 1980 and the Modaraba Compantes and : Modaraba Rules, 1981. The Registrar (Modarabas) with the approval of SECP vide order dated April 03, 2019 appointed Wasl Modaraba Management Limited (WMML) [Formerly Awwal Modaraba Management Limited (AMML)] to takeover and manage the affair of the Modaraba which was executed and effective from February 03, 2020. WMML (formerly AMMB) was wholly owned subsidiary of Pak Brunei Investment Company Limited (PBICL). 1.2 During the last reporting year, the Board of Directors of PBICL, decided to proceed with divestment of its total interest in WMML.
